title: Trump is using immigration policy to suppress speech, lawsuit claims
summary: A new lawsuit accuses the administration of violating the First Amendment by threatening the visas of researchers for work on disinformation and content moderation of social media.
contentText:
A new lawsuit accuses the administration of violating the First Amendment by threatening the visas of researchers for work on disinformation and content moderation of social media.

(Image credit: Anna Moneymaker, Janos Kummer and Heather Diehl)
